At most 25.0 MiB. Allowed types: pdf, png, jpg, jpeg, gif, webp, docx, xlsx, pptx, odt, ods, odp, rtf, txt, csv, md. The content must match the extension.

Scanning is not required on this installation: a file may be stored without being scanned, and is then marked Not scanned.
